messages:
Nina L.: heads up — ran the nightly KB scan and hit multiple /s/ shortlinks returning 410 on staging. saw redirects to the deprecation page for a few critical runtime docs. link: https://kb.redwood.ai/s/abc123 :eyes:

docs-bot: automated scan result: 12 pages with /s/ shortlinks returning 410 since 2026-03-16. report: https://internal/reports/shortlink-scan/2026-03-16

Devon: thanks for flagging. can you paste one failing URL and the expected destination?

Nina L.: example: https://kb.redwood.ai/s/abc123 should resolve -> https://kb.redwood.ai/docs/runtime/caching but currently 410/deprecation page.

Ryan H.: I own the runtime docs. i'll take first pass on the content side.

Maya: i can script replacements. plan: grep for shortlinks, convert internal references to absolute doc paths, open PRs per-owner. would that work?

Nina L.: yes. also looks like the shortlink mapping service removed those slugs during a cleanup — we may need a transient mapping restore for externally issued shortlinks.

Devon: i'll coordinate the mapping restore. can you file an issue and assign?

Nina L.: filed REDWOOD-4256 and added you + ryan.h. https://go/issue/REDWOOD-4256 — summary: restore critical shortlink mappings + batch doc updates.

Maya: quick find command i'll run to enumerate internal occurrences:

```
# from docs repo root
grep -R "kb.redwood.ai/s/" content/ | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u > /tmp/shortlink-files.txt
```

I'll open PRs that replace those with absolute paths and add owners as reviewers.

Ryan H.: prefer converting doc content to absolute paths long-term. shortlink mappings should be restored temporarily for external links we can't update.

Devon: agreed. action plan: 1) restore mapping for the 12 affected slugs in prod (short-term), 2) Maya to open PRs converting internal references (EOD), 3) announce shortlink deprecation schedule to external users and support (next-week). timeline: mapping restore today, PRs by EOD, announcement next week.

Nina L.: small PR pushed for one runtime page to update canonical path — https://go/pr/12345. please review.

Ryan H.: reviewed and left one nit. overall LGTM, will merge after nit addressed. :thumbsup:

Maya: starting the grep now. i'll open PRs with a standard commit message and mention owners. will include a note to keep mappings until 2026-06-30 unless we get objections.

docs-bot: mapping restore job scheduled by infra for 20:45 UTC. monitor logs post-deploy and alert if >5xx errors.

Devon: i'll follow up in REDWOOD-4256 with the rollback and rollout steps and who to notify (support, infra, docs).

Nina L.: thanks everyone. i'll add a runbook snippet to the issue about how to triage missing shortlinks (grep, mapping check, PR link pattern).

Ryan H.: good plan. let's sync in the weekly docs meeting to finalize the deprecation cadence.

Maya: ping me in the PRs if any owner needs help with bulk replacements.

Devon: closing loop here — update posted to the issue, mapping restore in progress. will post when done. :white_check_mark:
